**GTP-U Echo Request gets an Echo Response**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | GTPv1-U / Path Management Messages / Echo Request |
| Tags | none |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 15s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Owns | GTP-U Echo |
| Needs | no procedure first |

## Clauses

- TS 29.281 7.2.1 (Rel-8 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 adds the prefix "Even if there is no path in use," (absent in V8.0.0 and V14.1.0); unchanged through Rel-19)
- TS 29.281 7.2.2 (Rel-8 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)
- TS 29.281 4.3.1 (Rel-8 onward; Rel-11: "the GSN or RNC" (V8.0.0, V9.0.0) reads "the GTP-U entity" by V11.0.0 (Rel-10 not read); unchanged through Rel-19)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/GTPU-ECHO-RESPONSE.md).
